tool_input.description: Probe additional edge cases of ClassUtils ad hoc

result:
I wrote `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/ClassUtilsAgentTest.java` with 71 tests covering `ClassUtils`: null/boundary handling for name/canonical-name/package-name getters, `getAbbreviatedName` length-hint validation and the javadoc abbreviation examples, `getAllInterfaces`/`getAllSuperclasses`/`hierarchy` ordering (including interface inclusion and iterator `remove()`), `getClass` syntax variants (arrays, primitives, inner classes via dot-to-`$` retry, whitespace stripping) plus its documented `NullPointerException`/`ClassNotFoundException`/`IllegalArgumentException` boundaries (array-dimension >255, name length >65535), `getPublicMethod`'s bridging for non-public implementation classes, `isAssignable` primitive widening/autoboxing/null rules, `isInnerClass`/`isPublic`, primitive↔wrapper conversions, and `toClass`.

All 71 tests pass — I didn't find a genuine bug in `ClassUtils` after also probing additional edge cases (abbreviation with no dots/trailing/leading/empty path segments, nested array package names, `ClassCastException` on raw-typed misuse) ad hoc; none revealed incorrect behavior relative to the documented contract, so there are no failing tests to report.
